mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates strengthening residential investment and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity markets anticipate higher corporate earnings from construction-related sectors.
failure_condition: HOUST increases by more than 1.5% in the prior two months but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 6.0% in the most recent monthly reading, it signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 6.0% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in labor market strength (PAYEMS) and consumer demand (RSAFS) indicates a virtuous cycle of rising employment and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to immediate economic momentum.
failure_condition: The joint increase in PAYEMS and RSAFS occurs in more than 50% of the 5-day windows but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of those windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that may lead to further rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in the prior month, S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) in the most recent monthly reading, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 100.0 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as equity markets anticipate higher corporate profits from industrial output.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases by more than 1.5% in the prior two months but S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) signals an accommodative monetary policy combined with a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity markets anticipate both lower borrowing costs and higher consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in PAYEMS occurs in more than 50% of the 20-day windows but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of those windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% in the prior month but S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.
